d: Martin Escobari-Martin Escobari is Co-President of General Atlantic, has deployed over $5 billion into India, and grew up in a country that experienced 35,000% inflation, eleven presidents in a decade, and three coups before he turned twenty. He says the survivors of entrepreneurship are almost always people with a wound — intergenerational trauma, lost fortunes, public failure, something that won't let them sit still — and that the great fortunes of the next twenty years will be built in four places: AI, healthcare, the energy transition, and the new consumer in the global south.
